certification.name: CERT Certificate in Cybersecurity Oversight (NACD Cyber-Risk Oversight Program)
certification.description: Online self-paced programme of about 16 hours for board directors on overseeing cyber risk, with a cyber-crisis simulation. Each module ends with an exam that needs 80% to pass, all within one year of registration; the certificate does not expire.
certification.currency_note: Non-member price; NACD members $3,995. Certificate issued by the CERT Division of the Carnegie Mellon Software Engineering Institute
